🏗️oneblock but have cool technology🏗️

 

⚙️[English Description]

Welcome to oneblock but have cool technology—a definitive engineering challenge where precision meets the void.

Starting from a single infinite block, you must harness the laws of kinetic energy to build your destiny. Featuring a deep integration of the Create ecosystem, you will progress from primitive hand-cranked tools to massive, steam-powered industrial complexes. Defend your realm with Big Cannons, fuel your expansion with Diesel Generators, and master the elements with Create: New Age.

With Applied Energistics 2 managing your massive stockpiles and Farmer's Delight keeping you fed on your journey, you are not just surviving—you are innovating. Turn the gears of progress and transform a lonely speck of dust into a sprawling mechanical masterpiece.

 

 

⚙️[中文介紹 Chinese Description]

歡迎來到《oneblock but have cool technology》。這不僅僅是生存，這是一場關於精密機械與無限想像力的進化旅程。

你將從虛空中的一個方塊開始，但你並不孤單。憑藉 Create 模組及其強大的擴展集，你將見證黃銅齒輪的轉動、蒸汽引擎的轟鳴，以及大口徑火砲 (Big Cannons) 的威懾力。透過 Applied Energistics 2 構建你的數據大腦，並利用 Diesel Generators 與 New Age 徹底壓榨每一滴能源。

從手動挖掘到全自動化生產線，在這個只有方塊與齒輪的世界裡，唯一的限制是你的設計圖紙。

 

🛠️ Key Features| 模組包核心特色

  • Mechanical Mastery: 深度整合 Create 及其核心插件，實現 100% 自動化產線。

  • One Block Progression: 重新設計的階段性流程，從荒蕪之地走向高科技時代。

  • Industrial Power: 包含柴油動力、電力能源轉換與大規模武裝系統。

  • Quality of Life: 內建 AE2 與 Tom's Storage，徹底解決單方塊挑戰最痛苦的倉儲問題。
